biotools.summary: RummaGEO is a gene expression signature search engine for human and mouse RNA sequencing perturbation studies extracted from the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO). It automatically partitions studies into groups for differential expression analysis and provides a user-friendly search for gene sets.
